title: Two Hamzahs in One Word - أَنْ يُؤْتَىٰ
titleEn: Two Hamzahs in One Word - أَنْ يُؤْتَىٰ
description: The word أَنْ يُؤْتَىٰ is paired with an additional أَ for Imam Ibn Kathir. Thus while for the remaining qurra the rules of two hamazat don't apply here as for them there is only 1 hamzah in this word, for Imam Ibn Kathir they do.

tashil_of_second.title: Tashῑl of 2nd
tashil_of_second.description: Imam Ibn Kathir will pair the word أَنْ يُؤْتَىٰ with an additional hamzah making it: أَأَنْ يُؤْتَىٰ and recite the now second hamzah with tashῑl.
